UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile, language preference, security lock preference, and user-configured UPI transaction limits.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In.

preferredLanguage.description: Active UI locale code (English or Hindi).

biometricLockEnabled.description: Whether BiometricPrompt / device credential confirmation is required before payment initiation.

dailyLimitPaise.description: User daily UPI limit in paise (max 10000000 = INR 1,00,000).

perTxnLimitPaise.description: User single-transaction UPI limit in paise (max 10000000 = INR 1,00,000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UpiTransaction.title: UpiTransaction
UpiTransaction.description: UPI payment initiation and provider-verified settlement ledger entry.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the payer.

pspOrderId.description: Order ID issued by the RBI-regulated PSP backend (or precheck audit ID).

txRef.description: NPCI transaction reference (tr) generated by the PSP.

payeeVpa.description: Merchant or payee Virtual Payment Address (VPA).

payeeName.description: Merchant or payee name parsed from UPI QR.

pspVerified.description: True only when confirmed server-to-server by the authorized PSP.

utrNumber.description: Real NPCI UTR / RRN returned by the PSP (empty unless verified).

failureReason.description: Reason for failure, fraud block, or unconfigured PSP.

fraudFlags.description: Bounded list of fraud/limit rule flags triggered.

pspAppPackage.description: Authorized UPI PSP app package invoked for PIN entry, if applicable.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last status update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Beneficiary.title: Beneficiary
Beneficiary.description: Payee VPA record used to enforce NPCI 24-hour new-payee cooling limits.

isVerifiedMerchant.description: Whether merchant had valid MCC or signed QR.

firstPaidAt.description: Timestamp of first payment attempt to this VPA.

lastPaidAt.description: Timestamp of latest payment attempt to this VPA.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profile and transaction limit preferences.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{txId}.description: Owner-scoped UPI transaction ledger and receipt source.

/users/{userId}/beneficiaries/{vpaId}.description: Owner-scoped payee directory for 24-hour cooling limit enforcement.
